sections.title: Mental Health & Workforce Wellbeing Support Log
sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 55 and treats mental health as an occupational safety priority.

Procedure Capture: Record EAP communications, 988 resource postings, annual awareness training, and support referrals.

Task Use: Document non-clinical support actions and escalation to emergency services when crisis indicators are present.
